name_zh: 斯洛文尼亚工业/转型先驱：制造强国与欧盟融合模式
name_en: Slovenian Industry/Transition Pioneers: Manufacturing Powerhouse & EU Integration Model
description_zh: 斯洛文尼亚作为南斯拉夫最发达共和国 (人均 GDP 占联邦 20%+)，通过米兰·库昌 (1941-) 首任总统 (1990-2002) 稳健转型：保留工业基础 (汽车/制药/家电/机床)→私有化稳健/外资引入 (雷诺/葛兰素史克/博世)→2004 欧盟/北约入盟→2007 欧元区首个前南成员。核心转型模式：社会伙伴协商 (政府/工会/雇主三方)→出口导向制造升级→创新驱动 (研发占 GDP 2%+)。体现 M81 成本领先制造与 M151 北欧信任资本融合——以"社会对话+制造升级+欧盟锚定"三位一体，实现后共体制最高生活水平。
description_en: Slovenia as Yugoslavia's most developed republic (20%+ federal GDP per capita), achieved steady transition under Milan Kucan (1941-) 1st President (1990-2002): preserved industrial base (auto/pharma/appliances/machine tools) -> prudent privatization/FDI (Renault/GSK/Bosch) -> 2004 EU/NATO accession -> 2007 first ex-Yugoslav eurozone member. Core transition model: social partnership tripartite (govt/unions/employers) -> export-oriented manufacturing upgrade -> innovation-driven (R&D 2%+ GDP). Exemplifies M81 Cost Leadership Manufacturing fused with M151 Nordic Trust Capital—trinity of 'social dialogue + manufacturing upgrade + EU anchoring' achieving highest post-communist living standards.
reason_zh: 斯洛文尼亚转型独特在于"社会对话+工业保留+欧盟锚定"三位一体：避免了休克疗法去工业化，保住制造业占 GDP 25%+，人均 GDP 达中欧最高。M81+M151 结合，区隔于 M161 后苏联转型(乌克兰)、M170 威权稳定(白俄罗斯)、M163 斯拉夫边境(乌克兰)，核心在于"社会伙伴协商制+制造升级+欧盟融合"的中欧转型黄金标准。
reason_en: Slovenian transition unique in trinity of 'social dialogue + industrial retention + EU anchoring': avoided shock therapy deindustrialization, kept manufacturing 25%+ GDP, highest ex-Yugoslav GDP per capita. M81+M151 combined, distinct from M161 Post-Soviet Transition (Ukraine), M170 Authoritarian Stability (Belarus), M163 Slavic Borderland (Ukraine), core: 'social partnership + manufacturing upgrade + EU integration' Central European transition gold standard.
steps_zh: 社会伙伴协商制建立：政府/工会/雇主三方委员会，工资/价格/私有化/劳动法共识决策，避免冲突
稳健私有化与外资引入：内部员工持股/战略投资者招标/保留核心国企/雷诺雷克萨斯/葛兰素史克/博世入驻
制造升级与出口导向：汽车(雷诺/标致)/制药(克雷卡)/家电(哥伦布)/机床/绿色技术，出口占 GDP 80%+
欧盟/北约/欧元区锚定：2004 入盟/2007 欧元区/申根/经合组织，制度收敛驱动结构改革
创新驱动与绿色转型：研发 2%+ GDP/绿色技术/数字化/循环经济，人均 GDP 2023 超 $3 万
steps_en: Social partnership tripartite establishment: govt/unions/employers council, wages/prices/privatization/labor law consensus decisions, conflict avoidance
Prudent privatization & FDI attraction: employee buyouts/strategic investor tenders/retained core SOEs/Renault Revoz/GSK/Bosch entry
Manufacturing upgrade & export orientation: auto(Renault/Peugeot)/pharma(Krka)/appliances(Gorenje)/machine tools/green tech, exports 80%+ GDP
EU/NATO/eurozone anchoring: 2004 accession/2007 eurozone/Schengen/OECD, institutional convergence driving structural reforms
Innovation-driven & green transition: R&D 2%+ GDP/green tech/digitalization/circular economy, GDP per capita 2023 >$30k
expected_zh: 以"社会对话+制造保留+欧盟锚定"三位一体，实现后共体制最高生活水平/最低不平等/最快制度收敛，为中欧转型提供黄金标准范式。
expected_en: Trinity of 'social dialogue + industrial retention + EU anchoring' achieves highest post-communist living standards/lowest inequality/fastest institutional convergence, providing Central European transition gold standard paradigm.
case_zh: 人均 GDP 2023 $3.1 万(前南最高)/基尼系数 0.24(全球最低)/制造业占比 25%+/研发 2.1%/出口 $500 亿+/2007 欧元区首个前南成员，转型教科书案例。
case_en: GDP per capita 2023 $31k (ex-Yugoslavia highest)/Gini 0.24 (global lowest)/manufacturing 25%+/R&D 2.1%/exports $50B+/2007 first ex-Yugoslav eurozone member, transition textbook case.
cross_cultural_impact: Central European transition model; social partnership governance; manufacturing retention; EU integration speed
colonial_history: Austro-Hungarian; Italian/German occupation WWII; Yugoslav; Independent 1991
resource_curse_mitigation: No resource curse; manufacturing/services/knowledge economy; EU cohesion funds
